sections.title: Global Energy Policy: Challenges, Strategies, and Opportunities
sections.description: This course explores the dynamic and interconnected world of global energy policy, providing a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles, challenges, and solutions in the energy sector. Students will examine the economic, social, environmental, and geopolitical factors shaping energy policies worldwide, focusing on their impacts on people, nations, and ecosystems. Through a combination of lectures, case studies, a field trip and collaborative projects, students will analyze contemporary energy challenges, evaluate climate change mitigation strategies, and explore sustainable solutions that ensure equitable energy access for all.
